name: github-trending-tools
title: GitHub Trending Tool Server (MCP-compatible)
description: Fetch GitHub trending + repo metadata via tool-style invocations. Pick one tool per run: trending_repos, repo_details (with languages + contributors), user_repos, or search_repos. Anonymous works; optional GITHUB_TOKEN raises rate limit.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub Personal Access Token (optional)
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Anonymous calls work but are rate-limited (60/h). Add a PAT (no scopes needed for public read) to raise the limit to 5000/h.
